# ⚠️WAIT!!⚠️
This datapack was created by an **_inexperienced, non-English speaking_** developer, so please be aware that there may be oddities in the descriptions here, or that some features in this datapack may not work.

Also, this datapack is licensed [CC-BY](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en), which means you can use this datapack without permission for modpack or unofficial mod support, **_but please leave credit as possible!_**

## 📖 Overview

BalancedCraftingRecipes is a **vanilla-compatible data pack** (no mods required) that reworks dozens of crafting recipes around a single idea: *nothing should be a dead end*. Misplaced a dye? Re-dye the block. Over-built with slabs? Turn them back into planks. Got a worn-out anvil or a low-tier tool? Upgrade it at the smithing table instead of starting over. Found a rare pottery sherd? Duplicate it.

Every change keeps the vanilla feel — recipes stay intuitive and roughly cost-fair — while cutting out the busywork and the resource bleed that vanilla crafting often forces on you.

## ✨ Features

- **♻️ Recycle blocks back into materials** — Turn any copper block variant (waxed, oxidized, cut, chiseled, grate — every state) back into **9 copper ingots**. Smelt iron/gold blocks and other items back into their base resources.
- **🔄 Reverse crafting** — Convert slabs, stairs, walls, fences, doors, buttons, and glass panes back into the block or planks they came from. No more being stuck with the wrong shape.
- **⚒️ Smithing-table gear upgrade tree** — Promote tools and armor through tiers at the smithing table (e.g. **stone → copper → … → diamond**) instead of re-crafting from scratch. Includes **anvil repair** (damaged → chipped → anvil).
- **🪓 Stonecutter, now for wood & more** — Use the stonecutter to cut **logs into planks, slabs, stairs, doors, signs**, and to turn **raw deepslate into bricks/tiles/cobbled** variants. Far less waste than the crafting grid.
- **🎨 Universal dyeing (8× output)** — Re-dye **any** color of wool, carpet, bed, banner, concrete, concrete powder, terracotta, glazed terracotta, stained glass, glass panes, and bundles into another color — 8 at a time. Wrong-colored blocks are never garbage again.
- **📦 One-step & bulk crafting** — Craft **chest boats straight from planks + a chest**, make chest/furnace/hopper/TNT minecarts in one step, and produce colored beds, banners, bundles, and carpets directly. Plus bulk recipes like **16 sticks from logs**, **4 paper from a filled map**, and a **4× beehive**.
- **💎 Duplicate rare items** — Surround a **pottery sherd** with bricks to get **4 copies**, and craft **armor-trim smithing templates** (×2) so you never permanently lose one.
- **🧰 Quality-of-life extras** — Craftable **tinted glass** from any glass + amethyst, a cheaper **lodestone**, a new **stone spear**, ice ⇄ packed ice ⇄ blue ice conversions, and more.

> 💡 The recurring theme: if vanilla makes you re-grind, re-gather, or discard — this pack gives you a sensible recipe instead.

## 🔧 Installation

This is a **data pack**, not a mod — no loader needed.

**Single world**
1. Download the `.zip` (do **not** unzip it).
2. Place it in your world folder: `saves/<world-name>/datapacks/`.
3. In-game, run `/reload`, or leave and rejoin the world.

**Dedicated server**
1. Drop the `.zip` into `world/datapacks/`.
2. Run `/reload` or restart the server.

**Apply to every new world**
- On the *Create New World* screen, open **Data Packs** and drag the `.zip` in before creating the world.

## ⚙️ Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** Java Edition **1.21.9+** (pack format 88–95)
- **Environment:** Works on both **single-player and servers**
- **Mods:** None required — fully vanilla. Compatible with most resource/data packs.
- **Heads-up:** Because this pack overrides some vanilla recipe files, it may conflict with **other datapacks that change the same recipes**. If two packs edit the same recipe, **load order** decides which one wins.

## ❓ FAQ

<details>
<summary>Do I need Fabric, Forge, or any mod?</summary>

No. It's a pure data pack and runs on unmodified Minecraft.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Will it break my existing world or recipes?</summary>

It only adds or overrides crafting/smithing/stonecutting recipes — it doesn't touch your blocks, items, or saves. You can remove it at any time with `/datapack disable`.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Does it work on older versions like 1.20?</summary>

No. It targets 1.21.9 and newer (it relies on recent items such as copper tools/armor and shelves). Older versions use a different pack format.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Can I use it in a modpack on Modrinth?</summary>

Yes — you may include this pack in any Modrinth modpack, as long as you credit the original page.

</details>
